notes: Napoleon documentary, chapter 1 (Waterloo): 8 paintings x 4 seeds, 16:9, style ghm_painterly_v2. Client picks; nothing is final before approval.

shots.framing: wide landscape at eye level, rolling rye fields and a muddy country road in the foreground, a low ridge with a few elms across the middle distance
shots.scene: dawn after a night of heavy rain near Waterloo, Belgium, 1815, puddles and trampled wet rye, wisps of mist in the hollows, distant bivouac smoke from thousands of campfires, tiny ranks of soldiers on the far ridge
shots.lighting: grey wet dawn, low sun struggling through rain clouds, cold palette with a faint gold band on the horizon

shots.framing: epic panorama from a slight height, a shallow valley across the whole frame, dense blue French columns in the foreground right, red-coated lines and guns along the opposite ridge
shots.scene: the battlefield of Waterloo on the morning of 18 June 1815, French infantry and cuirassiers forming up near La Belle Alliance inn, Wellington's army on the ridge of Mont-Saint-Jean, the farm of La Haye Sainte in the valley, regimental eagles and colours
shots.lighting: overcast morning clearing slowly, diffuse light, damp air with atmospheric perspective

shots.framing: medium shot, the Emperor standing on a low rise on the left third, three-quarter view looking right through a field telescope, staff officers and a Guard chasseur holding horses behind him
shots.scene: Napoleon at Waterloo, 18 June 1815, near the farm of Rossomme, waiting for the ground to dry, maps on a camp table, wet grass and mud
shots.lighting: soft overcast late-morning light, a break in the clouds lighting the valley behind him

shots.framing: wide shot of a walled farm courtyard and its great north gate, defenders firing from loopholes and the walls, attackers in the orchard smoke
shots.scene: the farm of Hougoumont at Waterloo, 1815, British Foot Guards in red coats and stovepipe shakos holding the gate, the chateau barn on fire, French light infantry in blue among the trees
shots.lighting: afternoon light filtered through thick smoke, orange firelight from the burning barn
shots.negative_extra: text, letters, watermark, close-up wounds, blood, gore

shots.framing: dynamic wide shot at the height of a horseman, French cuirassiers in steel breastplates and crested helmets galloping from the left toward a British infantry square bristling with bayonets on the right
shots.scene: the French cavalry charges at Waterloo, 18 June 1815, Marshal Ney's heavy cavalry swirling around red-coated squares on the ridge, abandoned guns, trampled rye
shots.lighting: hazy afternoon sun through powder smoke, steel highlights on breastplates
shots.negative_extra: text, letters, watermark, close-up wounds, blood, gore

shots.framing: wide shot of a village street climbing to a stone church, Prussian infantry in dark blue coats advancing from the right, French Young Guard defending the churchyard wall
shots.scene: the village of Plancenoit at Waterloo, early evening 18 June 1815, houses on fire, smoke over the church tower
shots.lighting: low evening sun from the left, fire glow, heavy smoke
shots.negative_extra: text, letters, watermark, close-up wounds, blood, gore

shots.framing: low-angle wide shot looking up a long slope, columns of tall grenadiers in bearskins with red plumes and blue coats advancing toward the camera in step, drummers and an eagle standard
shots.scene: the Imperial Guard advancing at Waterloo, evening of 18 June 1815, veterans with grey moustaches, muskets shouldered, smoke drifting across the slope
shots.lighting: golden evening light from behind the columns, long shadows, rim light on bearskins

shots.framing: very wide shot, a lone rider in a grey greatcoat and bicorne seen from behind on the right third, watching a smoke-covered valley that fills the frame
shots.scene: the field of Waterloo at sunset, 18 June 1815, the outcome still undecided, smoke banks and the silhouette of the ridge
shots.lighting: blood-red sunset through smoke, deep shadows, dramatic sky
